Sandbox_MHP_EnableReplaceBandage_tooltip: Adds the 'Replace Bandage' context-menu entry for dirty bandages.
Sandbox_MHP_ShowSafeRemoveIndicator_tool: Shows the blue indicator when a bandage or splint can be removed safely.
Sandbox_MHP_ShowStitchInspectIndicator_t: Shows the purple indicator when stitched wounds should be checked.
